summary: Utah Wildflower Company is an Established (Digital Maturity 72) landscaper with strong demand signals — 4.8 stars from 71 reviews, claimed Google profile, and 10 detailed service pages — but measured site shows a clear performance bottleneck (mobile 56/100, 8.6s largest contentful paint, 16650ms interactive) and no online conversion path (0 forms, Online booking false). Priorities are speeding mobile load, adding a quote/estimate flow, tightening title/search clarity, and fixing accessibility gaps flagged in Lighthouse.

topOpportunities.title: Mobile load is bottlenecking otherwise-strong SEO foundation — 56/100 with 8.6s LCP and 16650ms time
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 56/100; largest contentful paint: 8.6s
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Homepage has 15 images, firstContentfulPaintMs 3671 and speedIndexMs 3702; even with SEO 92/100 and claimed profile, slow paint can reduce engagement on water-saving design queries.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Compress hero images, defer unused JavaScript (Lighthouse flags Est savings of 525 KiB), and audit Elementor/Wix script load. Target is stabilizing LCP before adding heavier conversion elements.

topOpportunities.title: No measurable online action path despite "Get your free design quote" intent
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage forms: 0; inputCount: 0 - crawled 10 same-site pages and checked 26 internal links found 0 forms site-wide
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Business profile shows Online booking false and Online estimates false with Online customer action points 0/10; all 10 crawled pages show 0 forms, so quote intent in description cannot be captured on-site.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add a single primary quote flow: sticky header "Get free design quote" + short form (name/phone/address/service) routed to existing hasPhone true / hasEmail true. Track as GA4 conversion since measurement stack already shows GA4.

topOpportunities.title: Search clarity flagged despite strong title — tighten homepage title/H1 alignment
topOpportunities.evidence: IssueDetail: The homepage title is missing or outside a useful descriptive range. - alternative measured fact Homepage title length: 70 characters with Page title: Salt Lake City Xeriscaping & Sustainable Landscaping | Utah Wildflower
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: SEO score is 92/100 and description already states "eco-friendly xeriscaping and native landscape design in Salt Lake City and across the Wasatch Front," but deterministic finding calls title out of range, risking clarity for core xeriscaping searches.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Keep title within useful range and front-load primary service + geo in plain language (e.g., Xeriscaping | Salt Lake City) and ensure one H1 per page — audit flagged heading-order and 2 pages with h1Count 2.

topOpportunities.title: Accessibility and usability nits — contrast, link names, touch targets
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility: 88/100 with failures: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio. and Links do not have a discernible name
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Image alt-text coverage: 87% is good but not full; with 3 CTA phrases detected and hasPhone true, clearer links and targets help mobile users reach quote action.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix flagged contrast ratios, add discernible names to links (6 links found with non-descriptive text), correct heading-order, and increase touch target spacing — small fixes that lift accessibility without redesign.
